ideas.title: Investigating Fraud Schemes in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent reports of fraud schemes in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme and a Medicaid fraud case.
questions: What are the details of the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme?
How did the Medicaid fraud case occur?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of fraud schemes in Minnesota, and I recommend using investigative reporting techniques to follow the money and uncover the truth.
